customMethods.name: deleteItemRates
customMethods.script:
for row in self.view.custom.table.selection.data:
		system.perspective.print("Deletinging %s"%row['itemAssetRateId'])
		system.kanoa.item.deleteItemAssetRate(row['itemAssetRateId'], self.view.custom.security.userId)
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
	
	return

customMethods.name: openRateEditor
customMethods.script:
itemAssetRateIds = [row['itemAssetRateId'] for row in self.view.custom.table.selection.data]
	system.perspective.openPopup("Item Rate Editor", view="kanoa/mes/config/items/itemRateEditor", params={'values':{'itemAssetRateIds':itemAssetRateIds}}, title='Item Rate Editor', overlayDismiss=True)
	
	return
